name: Bounty Hunter Horrors
short_description: Hunt for monsters through creepy dungeons on your own or with a squad of up to four in this sci-fi horror-based shooter! Navigate treacherous traps and escape the planet once the job is done. Purchase various kinds of equipment to make sure you and your squad are ready! The Main HQ will be watching.

name: Arcana Rift
short_description: Arcana Rift is a tactical 1v1 card battler set inside a mysterious theatre. Build tempo, manage mana, summon powerful Arcana, forge suit-based items, and outplay your opponent in online PvP or offline battles against the AI opponent

name: 100 Cats Lost in China 2 Find & Color
short_description: 🐱 Discover 500 hidden cats across 5 artistic hand-drawn scenes 🖌️. Relax with color-by-numbers 🎨 and add life to every detail. Play solo or in cozy co-op 👯‍♂️, while Meow FM 🎶 sets the perfect creative mood.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: NekoTrak
short_description: NekoTrak blends time tracking with focus-based pet care. Raise a cat that roams your desktop. Earn experience, collect coins, and unlock cats, and play multiplayer so your cats can meet. It tracks app and website time and shares your activity, music, and tasks on Steam and Discord.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー100人以上 +8

name: KYRO
short_description: KYRO is a top-down pixel art action-adventure. Play as Aiden, a boy with a trusty slingshot, exploring Ka'a on the edge of a black hole. Solve puzzles, uncover ruins, and help the people of Vila Carnaval face the apocalypse with laughter and party costumes!

name: Astro Yoinkers
short_description: Team up with your fellow Astro Yoinkers in this fast-paced multiplayer CTF. Physics-based grappling across moving asteroids, yoink enemy crystals, and vaporize lobbies with orbital strike satellites.

name: CyberCowboys
short_description: Saddle up for the wildest idle RPG this side of the Mississippi. Fight outlaws, duel rival cowboys, craft legendary gear, conquer world bosses, and build your frontier legacy — all set on a retro desktop OS straight outta 1998.
reasons: 成長/積み上げ要素: RPG +10
現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: Ant Clicker
short_description: Build a busy ant colony, one crumb at a time. Click or hold to gather food, recruit 10 castes, and watch workers carry supplies through a growing underground nest. Explore four minigames, discover seasonal rewards, and rebirth for permanent upgrades.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー10人以上 +5

name: Shelf-Employed
short_description: Restore order to a chaotic magical warehouse in this cozy first-person organizing simulator. Sort 4800+ packages into their proper places, unlock useful spells, and speed up your sorting. Turn towering piles of boxes into neatly filled shelves, one satisfying row at a time.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー10人以上 +5

name: Inspector Sommers in: Ouroborian Madness
short_description: Inspector Sommers in: Ouroborian Madness: The escape room that breaks the laws of physics and time. Investigation, time travel, and a warping mansion await in this Cold War-era mystery adventure.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: On Hold - Call Center Simulator
short_description: A dark comedy call center simulator where you answer calls, verify identities, catch fraudsters, and run side hustles under your supervisor's watchful eye. The queue never empties. The pay never improves.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: Natural Unintelligence: Zueirama 2
short_description: A chaotic adventure game packed with minigames and meme references, where you deliver pizzas, fight robots, pull pranks and take on an AI trying to wipe out the fun.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: Rooftops Parkour Pro
short_description: Physics-driven parkour sandbox with active ragdolls, NPC combat, tricks, wall runs, slides and dynamic environments. Explore detailed rooftop maps, experiment with movement and physics, and soon build your own playgrounds with the Level Builder.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: Ultimate Racing Simulator 1
short_description: Run a motorsport team in a detailed management simulation. Develop your car, manage drivers and staff, and plan race strategy across a full season. Follow the action in 2D or 3D as tyre wear, damage and weather shape the race.

name: No Cute Girl Can Stop My Sudoku
short_description: Sudoku, along with a cute desktop girl.

name: Catch The Fish
short_description: Catch The Fish is a chaotic fishing action-adventure where your catch fights back. Cast into lava, battle aggressive fish and powerful bosses, feed monstrous traders, and upgrade your weapons as you sail across seven strange and dangerous islands.

name: FUDAN ADVENTURE
short_description: A story-driven school-life RPG about friendship, academic pressure, and finding your voice. Explore campus with three companions, choose how to spend limited free time, and face exams and conflicts in turn-based battles. This release contains Chapter One.
reasons: 成長/積み上げ要素: RPG +10

name: Within
short_description: Immerse yourself in the atmospheric world of a first-person thriller. You will face a cunning criminal. Explore locations, solve puzzles, and try to escape the nightmare. But be careful: you can become not only the hunter but also the prey.

name: Warring States: Seven Hegemons
short_description: Rule a state in ancient China's Warring States era in this single-player, turn-based strategy game. Manage resources, recruit historical figures, enact reforms and navigate diplomacy. Grain spoils, armies need upkeep and conquered cities need pacification. Can your economy sustain your ambitions?
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: Sokoban: Ancient Ruins
short_description: A 3D Sokoban game with more than 900 levels. Push every crate onto a target, avoid dead ends, and take on later puzzles featuring irregularly shaped crates.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: Arcanum Idle
short_description: A study, a circle of chalk, and eight Sigils that make each other. A deep incremental about tearing down what you built: six nested prestige layers, a Constellation you arrange by hand, time magic paid for in resets, and a story with an ending.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: 429 - Four Twenty Knight
short_description: A physics-based VR puzzle game where you smash objects, uncover the right path forward, and survive swarms of creepy bugs.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: No Stars Football
short_description: A retro pixel-art soccer game with old-school arcade action on the pitch and a deep management sim underneath - play or simulate every match, build a squad, and take a club from the lower divisions to the title over a full multi-season career.
reasons: 現在プレイヤー1人以上 +2

name: R.O.A.D.K.I.L.L.
short_description: Race around in a rocket-powered shopping kart, or lay down obstacles to see who is the drift king in this neighbourhood!

name: Slingshot: Escape the solar system
short_description: Launch. Slingshot. Crash. Repeat. Slingshot is a pixel-art orbital mechanics arcade about gravity, fuel, and perfect timing. Chain flybys across eight planets, reach escape velocity, and tune in to Spacify : 12 destinations, 12 soundtracks, 100+ achievements.

name: NekoTrak - Supporter Pack
short_description: The NekoTrak Supporter Pack DLC adds 9 different looks for your cat.

name: Logic Puzzle Hall
short_description: Logic Puzzle Hall is a casual collection of math and logic puzzles. Deduce clues in Einstein-style mysteries, plan routes, and crack classic brainteasers—all in a cozy 2D interface with tutorials and multiple languages. Perfect for relaxing single-player sessions that train your reasoning.

name: Faybound : Veils of Magic
short_description: An ancient darkness threatens the balance of a magical world. Take on the roles of different fairies and unite their powers. Use their unique abilities to confront the emerging threat. Experience a hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania full of danger and mystical secrets.

name: Euphoria: Supreme Mechanics VR
short_description: Solve intricate puzzles in a mysterious sci-fi facility built for VR. Manipulate cubes, redirect lasers, activate mechanisms, and uncover the secrets of an abandoned research complex through hands-on interaction.

name: Sort Labs
short_description: Sort Labs is a casual first-person organization experiment: restore order to the laboratory full of geometric shapes and objects. Pick up and place each shape on the right shelf sorted by color and size. With customizable stages and multiple levels of difficulty, the experiments never end!
